Results.ReviewText:
This is my third Weber grill.  The last one I had for 16 years. I do not like the changes.  I use indirect heating a lot especially for my baby back ribs.  On my old grill I would grill them for 3 1/2 hours basting frequently the last 20 minutes.  The temperature would be 210 degrees. Perfect for long and slow cooking.  This grill's temperature will not go below 310 degrees !!  Indirect heating at this temperature is ridiculous.

My old grill had side that were either painted or  some sort of fiberglass.  They cleaned up with a cleaner spray easily and never showed marks etc. The new grill has a front snd sides made of stainless steel.  They are impossible to clean without having streaks.  So you have to get an expensive spray for stainless steel and that even takes unnecessary time.  And the side shelves show scratches!

Needless to say I am not happy with my new grill. But am stuck with it for now.
Results.Title: Not happy with the changes!

Results.ReviewText: This replaced a 17 year old Webber.  Overall a good grill although the materials used seem to be of a much lower quality than my previous one.  Assembly is easy and takes about an hour.  All features work as advertised.  My single complaint is that the grill does not heat up as well as my previous model.  Max temp is around 550 degrees which is fine however if you want to sear a piece of meat when initially starting cooking, it lacks the heat to do so.  Unfortunate as this can effect the juiciness of beef especially.  Otherwise cooks evenly and does a fine job.  I've tried different tanks hoping that would help to no avail

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill for our new second house on Cape Cod. I have a Genesis 3 series grill at home. This will be my third Weber propane grill and all have been great. They last a long time and continue to cook well until they finally die. My only criticism of this grill is the propane gauge to determine when the tank is empty. My old grill gauge could be adjusted so that when you put a full tank on,the gauge reads full after you adjust it (if necessary). The new grill has no adjustment capability so when I put a full tank on, it registers between 3/4 and full. It doesn’t matter to  me because I have two tanks and usually run the tank in use to empty and then switch. 
All in all, I would definitely buy it again.
Results.Title: Great grill except for propane tank gauge

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
